session_title_lang.title: Session title language
session_title_lang.description: Vocabulary the session-naming hook injects: en for MMDD|TYPE|subject, zh for MMDD|类型|主题. A locale tag such as zh-CN also resolves; anything else falls back to en.

orchestrator_models.title: Orchestrator models
orchestrator_models.description: Comma-separated, case-insensitive substrings of model ids the orchestrate hook treats as orchestrator-class: on those models the main thread may not edit project files and is told to delegate to subagents. Empty disables the hook.
